name: repolens
description: Explain the impact of a TypeScript code change with compiler-resolved dependency paths

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && vite build
scripts.dev: npm run build && node scripts/demo.mjs && node dist/server/index.js --repo data/demo
scripts.format: prettier --write src web tests scripts docs README.md CONTRIBUTING.md *.json vite.config.ts .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src web tests scripts docs README.md CONTRIBUTING.md *.json vite.config.ts .github/workflows/ci.yml
